author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam Savage reunites in the cave with legendary ILM model maker Lorne Peterson to talk custom tools, practical effects problem-solving, and the ingenuity that brought iconic Star Wars sequences to life. Lorne brings along some incredible custom tools — from hand-chipped flint and obsidian blades to handmade miniature Ewok arrows — and shares behind-the-scenes stories from The Empire Strikes Back, Return of the Jedi, Attack of the Clones, and Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom.

The Secret Technique Behind Classic Star Wars Ships: https://youtu.be/ivWJoOnof_s

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description: How do you animate a stop-motion eagle puppet — with a human on her back — soaring through the air? #AdamSavage chats with @LAIKAStudios' Dobrin Yanev about the #Wildwood sequence (featuring the characters the General and Prue) that took four YEARS to create.
title: Animating This Stop-Motion Sequence Took FOUR YEARS
